label: Suggested rule
creates_plan_start: Always remembers this kind of task: tasks that change files in {directory} on {machine} start without asking.
creates_standing: Always adds a standing authorization for {directory} on {machine}: {action}.
creates_delegate: Always stores no rule and turns nothing on: it only puts this suggestion away for 30 days.
made_plan_start: Remembered: tasks like this now start without asking.
made_delegate: No rule was stored and nothing was turned on.
where_delegate: No app has a switch for this yet: it is turned on in the assistant's configuration file on the hub's computer ({setting}).
